nurse.text: Hello, dear. Come in, mind the step. We're Roman, we have excellent heating.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop them over here. We'll have them right as a legion in no time.
The Ark's by the wall. Keep your pets off the Roman mosaic.

else.text: No bother. We've been here nearly two thousand years. We're not in a hurry.
